---
title: "NASA Meteorite Landings Explorer"
author: "Sam Panzica"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    vertical_layout: fill
    theme:
      version: 4
      bootswatch: flatly
    source_code: embed
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(plotly)
library(leaflet)
library(DT)
library(crosstalk)
library(scales)

max_found <- 8000
set.seed(8030)

# ---- Import --------
raw <- read_csv("Meteorite_Landings.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# ---- Tidy + Transform ------
meteorites <- raw |>
  clean_names() |>
  rename(any_of(c(mass_g = "mass", lat = "reclat", long = "reclong"))) |>
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(str_extract(as.character(year), "\\d{4}"))
  ) |>
  filter(
    nametype == "Valid",
    !is.na(year), !is.na(lat), !is.na(long), !is.na(mass_g),
    mass_g > 0,
    !(lat == 0 & long == 0),
    year >= 860, year <= as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"))
  ) |>
  mutate(
    decade    = floor(year / 10) * 10,
    mass_kg   = mass_g / 1000,
    log_mass  = round(log10(mass_g), 2),
    class_group = case_when(
      str_detect(recclass, "^(H|L|LL)($|[0-9~/(-])")      ~ "Ordinary chondrite",
      str_detect(recclass, "^C(I|M|O|V|K|R|B|H)|^C$|^C[0-9]") ~ "Carbonaceous chondrite",
      str_detect(recclass, "^E[HL]?[0-9]")                ~ "Enstatite chondrite",
      str_detect(recclass, "^Iron")                       ~ "Iron",
      str_detect(recclass, "Pallasite|Mesosiderite")      ~ "Stony-iron",
      str_detect(recclass, "Eucrite|Diogenite|Howardite|Martian|Lunar|Angrite|Aubrite|Ureilite|Acapulcoite|Lodranite|Brachinite") ~ "Achondrite",
      TRUE                                                ~ "Other / unclassified"
    ),
    class_group = factor(class_group)
  ) |>
  select(name, id, recclass, class_group, fall, year, decade,
         mass_g, mass_kg, log_mass, lat, long)


map_df <- bind_rows(
  meteorites |> filter(fall == "Fell"),
  meteorites |> filter(fall == "Found") |> slice_sample(n = max_found)
) |>
  mutate(
    lat  = round(lat, 3),
    long = round(long, 3),
    popup = paste0(
      "<b>", name, "</b><br>",
      "Class: ", recclass, "<br>",
      "Year: ", year, " (", fall, ")<br>",
      "Mass: ", comma(mass_g), " g"
    )
  )

sd <- SharedData$new(map_df)
fall_pal <- colorFactor(c("darkgreen", "lightblue"), domain = c("Fell", "Found"))
```

Overview
=====================================

Row
-------------------------------------

### Meteorites in dataset

```{r}
valueBox(comma(nrow(meteorites)), icon = "fa-globe", color = "primary")
```

### Observed falls

```{r}
valueBox(comma(sum(meteorites$fall == "Fell")),
         caption = "Observed falls", icon = "fa-eye", color = "danger")
```

### Heaviest specimen

```{r}
heaviest <- meteorites |> slice_max(mass_g, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
valueBox(paste0(heaviest$name, " (", comma(heaviest$mass_kg / 1000), " t)"),
         icon = "fa-weight-hanging", color = "warning")
```

### Median mass

```{r}
valueBox(paste(comma(median(meteorites$mass_g)), "g"),
         icon = "fa-balance-scale", color = "info")
```

Row
-------------------------------------

### Recorded meteorites by decade

```{r}
by_decade <- meteorites |> count(decade, fall)

plot_ly(by_decade, x = ~decade, y = ~n, color = ~fall,
        colors = c("Fell" = "darkgreen", "Found" = "lightblue"),
        type = "bar") |>
  layout(barmode = "stack",
         xaxis = list(title = "Decade"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Number of meteorites"),
         legend = list(title = list(text = "Discovery")))
```

### Mass distribution (log scale)

```{r}
plot_ly(meteorites, x = ~log_mass, color = ~fall,
        colors = c("Fell" = "darkgreen", "Found" = "lightblue"),
        type = "histogram", nbinsx = 40, opacity = 0.7) |>
  layout(barmode = "overlay",
         xaxis = list(title = "log10(mass in grams)"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Count"))
```

Explorer
=====================================

Inputs {.sidebar}
-------------------------------------

**Filter the map, plot and table**

```{r}
filter_select("fall", "Discovery type", sd, ~fall)
filter_select("grp", "Meteorite group", sd, ~class_group)
filter_slider("year", "Year", sd, ~year, sep = "", step = 1)
filter_slider("mass", "log10 mass (g)", sd, ~log_mass, step = 0.1)
```

*Fell = seen falling; Found = discovered later. A log10 mass of 3 is 1 kg; 6 is 1 tonne.*

Row {data-height=550}
-------------------------------------

### Where meteorites were recorded (click clusters to zoom)

```{r}
leaflet(sd) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~long, lat = ~lat,
    radius = 5, stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0.7,
    color = ~fall_pal(fall),
    popup = ~popup,
    clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions()
  ) |>
  addLegend("bottomright", pal = fall_pal, values = c("Fell", "Found"),
            title = "Discovery")
```

Row {data-height=450}
-------------------------------------

### Mass vs. year of recording

```{r}
plot_ly(sd, x = ~year, y = ~log_mass, color = ~class_group,
        type = "scattergl", mode = "markers",
        text = ~name, hoverinfo = "text+x+y",
        marker = list(opacity = 0.5, size = 5)) |>
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
         yaxis = list(title = "log10(mass in grams)"),
         legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.25)) |>
  highlight("plotly_selected")
```

### Data table

```{r}
datatable(
  sd,
  rownames = FALSE,
  colnames = c("Name", "ID", "Class", "Group", "Fall", "Year", "Decade",
               "Mass (g)", "Mass (kg)", "log10 mass", "Lat", "Long", "Popup"),
  options = list(
    pageLength = 8, scrollX = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(list(visible = FALSE, targets = c(1, 6, 8, 12)))
  ),
  extensions = "Buttons"
)
```

Classification
=====================================

Row
-------------------------------------

### 15 most common meteorite classes

```{r}
meteorites |>
  count(recclass, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~n, y = ~reorder(recclass, n), type = "bar",
          orientation = "h", marker = list(color = "lightblue")) |>
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Number of meteorites"),
         yaxis = list(title = ""))
```

### Mass by meteorite group

```{r}
plot_ly(meteorites, y = ~log_mass, color = ~class_group, type = "box") |>
  layout(yaxis = list(title = "log10(mass in grams)"),
         xaxis = list(title = ""),
         showlegend = FALSE)
```

Row
-------------------------------------

### Share of each group among falls vs. finds

```{r}
meteorites |>
  count(fall, class_group) |>
  group_by(fall) |>
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n)) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~fall, y = ~pct, color = ~class_group, type = "bar") |>
  layout(barmode = "stack",
         yaxis = list(title = "Share of meteorites", tickformat = ".0%"),
         xaxis = list(title = ""))
```

About
=====================================

### Data and notes

### Data and notes

**Source:** NASA Open Data Portal, *Meteorite Landings* (compiled from The Meteoritical Society's Meteoritical Bulletin Database).

**Cleaning steps:** removed relict records, rows missing year, mass or coordinates, placeholder coordinates at (0, 0), and implausible years. Meteorite classes were grouped into broad categories for easier comparison.

**Key variables:** `fall` (Fell = observed falling, Found = discovered later), `mass_g` (grams), `recclass` (classification), `year`, `lat`/`long` (decimal degrees).

**Caveats:** Recording effort is uneven. Finds cluster in Antarctica and deserts where meteorites are easy to spot and preserve, and iron meteorites are over-represented among finds because they survive weathering and stand out. The interactive pages use all observed falls plus a random sample of finds.

*Dashboard built with flexdashboard, plotly, leaflet, DT and crosstalk.*
